basic_info.description: Welcome to one of the largest and most charming condos in the NoPa/Alamo Square neighborhood, a block away from Alamo Square Park, the Painted Ladies and the great Divisadero Street commercial district with some of the best restaurants and shops in San Francisco.  This middle floor flat features tall ceilings, light-filled Victorian architecture, 3-4 bedrooms, two bathrooms and large living and formal dining rooms.  Two bedrooms are in the south facing rear of the home, including the primary suite and laundry area.  Another bedroom is in the front of the home and a potential fourth bedroom or office is in the middle of the main hallway.  City and hillside views are seen from the back bedrooms.  A nicely manicured garden and garage parking for one car are in the back of the building.  Lots of storage space on the ground floor is available.
